priceProvenance.basis: Native published peak USD rates. Off-peak billing can be lower. Usage-priced amounts are estimates, not invoices.
priceProvenance.reasoning: completion_tokens includes reasoning tokens; reasoning_tokens is never charged a second time.

callOrder: calibration then holdout; alternating model order by task index; no retries
splitPolicy: Fixed before any provider call: one task per kind and complexity in calibration, and one in holdout. Never tune with holdout answers or outcomes.
network: direct native DeepSeek chat-completions, no tools, no AgenC orchestration
